brand.name: Barber Shop Crew
brand.tagline: La única barbería de su universo
brand.logo: solo en la interfaz (no dentro de las imágenes)

art_direction.style_block: Cinematic futuristic sci-fi, photoreal CGI, deep black space with subtle purple and teal nebula haze, barber-pole color accents of red, white and electric blue as glowing light, volumetric light rays, anamorphic film look, high contrast, crisp detail, 35mm lens feel.
art_direction.lighting: Same cold rim light from the upper right and warm red-blue neon glow as accent in every image.
art_direction.motion_style: Smooth unbroken spacecraft-like flight, constant speed, gentle banking, no shake; scale and lighting stay consistent.
art_direction.negative: text, letters, logos, watermark, people's faces, cartoon, low quality, blurry, extra limbs

world.overview: Deep space: the planet Earth glowing blue in the distance, the Mediterranean coast of Spain catching the first light, and beyond it a faint red-white-blue spiral rift in space that hints at another universe.

chapters.title: Rumbo a la Tierra
chapters.copy: Atravesamos el espacio hasta un punto concreto: Av. Ancha de Castelar, 187.
chapters.scene: planet Earth seen from low orbit, night side, the city lights of Alicante and Sant Vicent del Raspeig glowing, one tiny point pulsing red and blue
chapters.entry: a break in the clouds right above the pulsing point of light
chapters.interior: flying low over a quiet night-time Spanish avenue with palm trees and wet asphalt reflecting neon, a single shop front glowing red and blue at the end of the street

chapters.title: Al otro lado
chapters.copy: Degradados, barba, color y diseño. Pasa por el portal y deja el resto del mundo fuera.
chapters.scene: the glowing shop front opening into a swirling vortex made of rotating red, white and blue barber-pole stripes of light
chapters.entry: the bright centre of the spinning spiral
chapters.interior: inside a long tunnel of spinning red, white and blue light stripes, chrome scissors and straight razors floating weightless like asteroids

chapters.title: Universo Crew
chapters.copy: 4,8 ★ con 356 reseñas en Google. Lunes a viernes, 10:00–13:30 y 16:30–20:30. Llama al 966 17 09 82.
chapters.scene: a strange empty universe of violet fog and floating light particles where the only thing that exists is one industrial barbershop interior floating like an island, with exposed silver ducts, hanging industrial pendant lamps and vintage leather barber chairs
chapters.entry: the open glass front of the floating barbershop
chapters.interior: inside the barbershop: vintage leather barber chair in the centre under industrial pendant lamps, exposed silver ventilation ducts on the dark ceiling, wood-look floor, framed pictures and a guitar on the wall, the alien violet universe visible through the windows

keyframes.prompt: Cinematic futuristic sci-fi, photoreal CGI, deep black space with subtle purple and teal nebula haze, volumetric light, anamorphic film look, high contrast, crisp detail. Wide establishing shot from deep space: planet Earth in the middle of the frame, medium size, night side with glowing city lights, a thin bright sunrise line along the Mediterranean coast of Spain. Far behind the Earth, a faint spiral rift in space glowing red, white and electric blue like a barber pole, hinting at another universe. Thousands of sharp stars. Cold rim light from the upper right. Calm, epic, empty. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no spacecraft, no people.
keyframes.negative: text, letters, logos, watermark, people, faces, cartoon, low quality, blurry, multiple planets, moon in foreground

clips.prompt: (hecho) nubes → ciudad → avenida frente al portal

One continuous single-take camera move, no cuts. Starting exactly on @Image1 (night avenue facing a glowing red-white-blue spiral portal in a shop doorway), the camera glides forward along the wet street, enters the spinning spiral portal and flies inside a tunnel of spinning red, white and blue light stripes with floating chrome scissors and razors, arriving exactly on @Image2. Constant smooth speed, no shake. No text, no logos.

One continuous single-take camera move, no cuts. Starting exactly on @Image1 (inside a tunnel of spinning red, white and blue light), the camera rushes toward the bright light at the end of the tunnel, bursts out into a strange violet universe and slows down in front of a single barbershop floating like an island, arriving exactly on @Image2. Constant smooth speed, no shake. No text, no logos.

One continuous single-take camera move, no cuts. Starting exactly on @Image1 (a barbershop floating like an island in a violet universe, its glass front open), the camera glides forward through the open glass front into the barbershop and settles at eye level facing the vintage leather barber chair under industrial pendant lamps, arriving exactly on @Image2. Constant smooth speed, no shake. No text, no logos.
